results.title: Genie Mentions: AI that gets you *and* the people in your life, together | Product Hunt
results.content: The neat thing about Mentions is that it’s an AI that is designed to be multiplayer from the ground up - to have separate private and public-facing memories and models designed to make use of them. This hasn’t been easy (there’s a reason everyone else defaults to just trying to make a “single-player” experience work well), but as you and people in your circle use it, you can start to see why it was worth the effort. When Mentions knows those around you who help define your life, it feels immensely more useful, more surprising, and more fun than AIs that were designed to exist in a social silo.

 ### Q: Which collaboration platforms offer built-in AI workflows for async communication?

  Loom and Attio both offer built-in AI workflows that help with async communication.

  + Loom: automatically produces readable output from video messages (transcripts/summaries) so teammates can skim or read instead of rewatching.
  + Attio: Automations include AI blocks (Summarize, Classify, custom prompts) that turn unstructured sources—emails, calls, Slack—into structured data and run automations for follow‑ups or routing.
